column1: # Canonical 56-variant table for the genome-wide screen (Methods §2.3;
# Results; Fig. 2; Table S4). This file is the single source of truth for
# the 56 candidate gnsRVs and is consumed by:
#   - Any downstream analysis referencing the genome-wide screen variant set
# Each variant is present in >=3 of 26 metastatic patients in the discovery
# Extreme Phenotype Cohort and absent from all 26 non-metastatic patients.
#   epc_met_carriers     : number of carriers in the metastatic arm (n=26)
#   v211_nfe_af          : gnomAD v2.1.1 non-Finnish European MAF
#   v411_wes_af_frozen   : gnomAD v4.1.1 exome (WES) MAF at the time the
#                          variant set was finalized for submission.
#   v411_wes_af_current  : gnomAD v4.1.1 exome (WES) MAF at the time this
#                          file was retrieved. May differ from frozen if
#   v411_nfe_af          : gnomAD v4.1.1 non-Finnish European MAF;
# fathmm_mkl_*, evee_pathogenicity, and alphamissense_score are raw
# scores from independent tools with different scales, training data,
# and recommended thresholds. Any tool-specific threshold noted below
# is the original authors' published suggestion, not a universal
# cutoff — and recommendations have evolved with each tool's
# recalibration. Consult each tool's current documentation for
# thresholds appropriate to your use case before making binary calls.
#   fathmm_mkl_score     : FATHMM-MKL coding score (Shihab et al. 2015,
#                          N = neutral, NA = not annotated). Derived from
#   evee_pathogenicity   : Evo Variant Effect Explorer (EVEE) pathogenicity
#                          score [0–1]; higher = more pathogenic. NA = not
#                          covered by EVEE (30/56 variants here). See EVEE
#   clinvar_clndbn       : ClinVar associated disease name (CLNDBN; dbNSFP 3.0a)
#   clinvar_clndsdb      : ClinVar disease cross-reference database (CLNDSDB; dbNSFP 3.0a)
#   clinvar_clndsdbid    : ClinVar disease database identifier (CLNDSDBID; dbNSFP 3.0a)
